text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq calls on Iran to stop meddling in its internal affairs.
- Iraq launched 93 Scud missiles during the 1991 Gulf War over Kuwait.
- Foreign minister in Amman on way to New York.
- Kuwaiti authorities perpetrate vicious crime against Iraqi citizen.
- (The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA).
- U.N. releases funds from partial oil sales.
- Iraq is ready to export oil by-products.
- Article on lessons to be learned from the 1991 Gulf War over Kuwait.
- France ready to supply Iraqi civil planes with spare parts.
- Some 20 European companies to hold medical exhibition in Baghdad.
- Turkey to organise trade week in Baghdad next week.
